claude.sample_unit: participants (chest radiographs) from a TB prevalence survey

links.outcome: AI accuracy across subgroups (age, HIV status, TB history)
links.effect: All products generally performed worst in older individuals, people with previous tuberculosis, and people with HIV; thresholds, sensitivity, and specificity varied across groups.
links.quote: All products generally performed worst in older individuals, people with previous tuberculosis, and people with HIV.

links.outcome: Comparative accuracy (AUC) of 12 commercial CAD products on same data
links.effect: Lunit and Nexus had AUCs near 0.9; qXR, JF CXR-2, InferRead, Xvision, ChestEye 0.8-0.9; XrayAME, RADIFY, TiSepX-TB under 0.8.
links.quote: Diverse accuracy was noted: Lunit and Nexus had AUCs near 0·9, followed by qXR, JF CXR-2, InferRead, Xvision, and ChestEye (AUCs 0·8-0·9).
